changelog: 1.1 - Weapon pages, hooks, gateways and models re-split into melee / ranged / firearms per ADR-001

objective.technical_goal: Structure erebus-app, currently a plain Vite+React scaffold with no domain logic, as an MVVM application that consumes erebus-api to provide read-only search (listing, search, filter and detail) over the Daemon System tables: melee weapons, ranged weapons, firearms, protections, skills and enhancements. This document covers only the technical how of the solution (architecture, components, flows, data, interfaces, stack, scalability, security and observability); the design system (visual tokens, UI components) is documented separately in erebus-app/docs/design.
problems_addressed: erebus-app has no domain logic, HTTP client, routing or defined layers yet
No structured, queryable data source exists for the Daemon System rules on the client side
The future Erebus Engine (Phase 2) has no validated client architecture reference to follow
linked_systems: erebus-api (sole external integration, consumed read-only via REST/JSON)

architecture.topology_overview: Single-page application (SPA) built with React, Vite and TypeScript, organized in MVVM. The Model layer holds per-entity Gateways (Axios) and pure TypeScript types, agnostic of React or any UI library. The ViewModel layer is implemented as domain hooks (one per entity) that consume the Gateways and expose state and methods to the View via destructuring. The View layer is composed of layouts, pages and React components (tsx), with no direct HTTP calls. Routing via React Router DOM, with two layouts (landing and main) containing nested pages.
patterns: Gateway pattern in the Model layer (one Axios Gateway per entity, mirroring erebus-api endpoints)
Domain hooks as ViewModel (e.g. useSkills, useMeleeWeapons)
REST/JSON as the integration protocol with erebus-api
Client-side search and filter over the full dataset loaded per entity

components.name: MainLayout
responsibilities: Navigation shell for the remaining pages (AboutPage and the 6 listing pages)

components.name: MeleeWeaponsListPage
responsibilities: List, search and filter melee weapons

components.name: RangedWeaponsListPage
responsibilities: List, search and filter non-firearm ranged weapons (bows, crossbows) and thrown weapons
Display a note stating these are canonically tested under the Armas Brancas* skill

components.name: MeleeWeaponDetail / RangedWeaponDetail / FirearmDetail / ProtectionDetail / SkillDetail / EnhancementDetail
responsibilities: Per-entity modal detail components, displaying all fields and the source/trust level
Weapon details additionally display the governing Daemon skill (skillGroup) as a first-class field

components.name: Domain hooks (useMeleeWeapons, useRangedWeapons, useFirearms, useProtections, useSkills, useEnhancements)
responsibilities: ViewModel: orchestrate Gateway calls, hold state (data, loading, error), expose in-memory search/filter

components.name: Gateways (meleeWeaponsGateway, rangedWeaponsGateway, firearmsGateway, protectionsGateway, skillsGateway, enhancementsGateway)
responsibilities: Encapsulate Axios calls to erebus-api, map responses to Models

components.name: Models (pure TS types)
responsibilities: Represent entities coming from the API (MeleeWeapon, RangedWeapon, Firearm, Protection, Skill, Enhancement), including provenance fields

components.name: Shared UI components (/src/components)
responsibilities: Search bar, source-level filter, generic modal, loading/error indicators
dependencies: Used by pages and their own page-specific components

request_flow: User navigates to a listing page (e.g. SkillsListPage) inside MainLayout
Domain hook (useSkills) fires on mount, calling skillsGateway.list()
Gateway performs GET /skills on erebus-api, receiving all records at once
Response is mapped to Skill[] (pure TypeScript Model)
Hook holds the full list in state and exposes data, loading, error and search/filter methods
Search and filter are applied in memory, without a new request
Loading shown via spinner/skeleton; error or empty result shown inline on the page, with a complementary global toast/snackbar notification
User clicks an item, opening the corresponding modal (e.g. SkillDetail)
Response mapped to the Model and displayed in the modal, including source and trust level
Loading via spinner/skeleton inside the modal; error inline in the modal with a complementary global notification; no automatic retry
data_flow: SQLite (erebus-api) -> JSON REST response -> Gateway (Axios) -> Model (pure TypeScript) -> domain hook state (ViewModel) -> View (props via destructuring) -> rendering

entities: MeleeWeapon (knives, daggers, swords, axes, clubs, maces, spears; includes unarmed combat)
RangedWeapon (bows and crossbows, plus thrown weapons - the latter are the same records returned by MeleeWeapon with isThrown true, not duplicates)
Skill (with nested subgroups and base attribute)
relationships: No cross-entity relationships are navigated by the application in this phase; each entity is queried in isolation. The skillGroup field on weapon models is displayed as text, not as a navigable link to the corresponding skill
data_model.source_of_truth: erebus-api (SQLite). erebus-app does not persist or cache data across sessions (no localStorage/IndexedDB); every page load triggers a fresh request. All entities include the common provenance fields defined by erebus-api: nivelFonte, fonte and, when applicable, edicaoOuVersao.

strategies: Static SPA served via CDN (Netlify); horizontal scaling managed by the platform, no own server to scale
No automatic retry on erebus-api failure in this phase
Axios timeout configured; errors handled via inline state on the page/modal, complemented by a global notification
scalability_availability.caching: None (no local caching of API data; no localStorage/IndexedDB)
scalability_availability.sla_target: 99.9% for the web application (hypothesis, Netlify platform), also dependent on erebus-api availability, outside erebus-app's direct control

security.authentication: Not applicable in this phase: public, read-only application, no user login
security.authorization: Not applicable in this phase: all queried data is public
security.secrets_management: No real secrets in erebus-app; the VITE_API_BASE_URL environment variable only exposes the public API URL, not a credential. No secret is embedded in the client bundle
security.encryption_in_transit: HTTPS between erebus-app, Netlify and erebus-api
security.encryption_at_rest: Not applicable: no data is persisted on the client (no local cache)
security.pii_policy: Not applicable: no personal data (PII) is collected, displayed or processed

observability.logs: Structured console.error for request failures, with no external service integration in this phase
dashboards_alerts: Limited to the Netlify build/deploy dashboard

risks.impact: In-memory search and filter become slow if Level 2/3 curation significantly expands the lists
mitigation: Migrate to server-side pagination/filtering if needed
risks.contingency_plan: Revise domain hooks to adopt server-side filtering, reusing the search parameters already defined in erebus-api endpoints

risks.risk: Lack of automatic retry on transient network failures
risks.impact: Momentary API instability appears as a visible error to the user, with no automatic recovery
risks.contingency_plan: Re-evaluate retry with backoff if the problem proves recurrent in production

risks.impact: Real production failures may go unnoticed, hindering diagnosis
mitigation: Adopt the lightweight error tracking recommendation described in Observability
risks.contingency_plan: Manual monitoring via user reports until a dedicated tool is adopted

risks.risk: Ranged Weapons menu implies a skill that does not exist in the Daemon System
risks.impact: User infers bows and crossbows are tested under a 'ranged weapons' skill, when they are canonically tested under Armas Brancas*
mitigation: skillGroup displayed as a first-class field on every weapon detail modal
Explanatory note in the header of RangedWeaponsListPage
Thrown weapons visibly flagged as also appearing in the melee listing (same record, same id)
risks.contingency_plan: Merge the melee and ranged listings behind a single Weapons entry with a category filter, should the confusion be reported in use

risks.risk: Direct coupling between erebus-app Models and the erebus-api response contract
risks.impact: A schema change in the API without versioning breaks Gateways/Models without prior warning
mitigation: Validate the contract via integration tests (Vitest) with mock responses faithful to the real schema
risks.contingency_plan: Adjust Gateways and Models in isolation, with no impact on View/ViewModel, given the MVVM isolation

adrs: ADR-001 - Three-way weapon taxonomy (melee / ranged / firearms) as the product-facing category (docs/decisions/ADR-001-weapon-taxonomy-melee-ranged-firearms.md)
pending_decisions: Future need for server-side pagination/filtering if the catalog grows
Adoption of an error tracking tool (e.g. Sentry)
next_steps: Implement routing with React Router DOM (LandingLayout -> HomePage; MainLayout -> AboutPage + 6 listing pages)
Implement Axios Gateways per entity and their corresponding domain hooks
Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL per environment and the Netlify deploy pipeline
Write unit/integration tests (Vitest) for Gateways and hooks, and E2E tests (Playwright) for search/filter/detail flows
Detail the design system in erebus-app/docs/design (outside this HLD)
Formalize the ADR candidates listed above
